initial_observation.title: Lowsail Checkpoint
initial_observation.text: Sava watches your wanted face while workers leave a gap; reach Red Sluice before the next surge.

observation.title: Lowsail Docks
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Boats knock against the docks. Oren watches a courier skiff beside a locked tide chest.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Lowsail Docks
observation.text: You sound the market warning. Oren sends loading crews uphill; relay his warning at Lowsail Levee so Edrik can open relief. The loading crews have cleared the docks; Oren and Yara remain beside the warning bell.
observation.result: You sound the market warning. Oren sends loading crews uphill; relay his warning at Lowsail Levee so Edrik can open relief.

observation.title: Lowsail Levee
observation.text: You rig your rope and wire; Oren's crew tows you to Lowsail Levee for three coins. They return your gear and point out Culvert Path into Red Sluice. The levee crew moves uphill because Lowsail expects the next surge.
observation.result: You rig your rope and wire; Oren's crew tows you to Lowsail Levee for three coins. They return your gear and point out Culvert Path into Red Sluice.

observation.title: Lowsail Levee
observation.text: Oren's warning reaches Edrik; he can now help open relief at Red Sluice Floor. The levee crew moves uphill because Lowsail expects the next surge.
observation.result: Oren's warning reaches Edrik; he can now help open relief at Red Sluice Floor.

observation.title: Red Sluice Floor
observation.text: The hidden culvert opens below the Sluice. Heat marks reveal stress above the intake.
observation.result: The hidden culvert opens below the Sluice.

observation.title: Red Sluice Floor
observation.text: Edrik follows the warning and opens the safer channel. Heat marks reveal stress above the intake.
observation.result: Edrik follows the warning and opens the safer channel.

observation.title: Red Sluice Top
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Mira points to a relief wheel that gives the warned market one safe escape.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Red Sluice Top
observation.text: The control wheels turn, but the split still needs a choice. Mira points to a relief wheel that gives the warned market one safe escape.
observation.result: The control wheels turn, but the split still needs a choice.

observation.title: Red Sluice Top
observation.text: The relief channel takes the surge away from the market. This surge is settled; choose Return to Lowsail to see the result.
observation.result: The relief channel takes the surge away from the market.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You return to Lowsail's changed market. Oren, Sava, and Mira watch families carry goods toward higher ground beyond the empty stalls.
observation.result: You return to Lowsail's changed market.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You help families open a higher market beyond the next surge. Oren, Sava, and Mira watch families carry goods toward higher ground beyond the empty stalls.
observation.result: You help families open a higher market beyond the next surge.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: The tide shifts one step. Oren, Sava, and Mira watch families carry goods toward higher ground beyond the empty stalls.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop. Nessa offers two clay and one mesh for plugs or screening; optional work uses tide steps. Plugs unlock Lowsail's three-coin sorting job after the tide; screening saves two stamina loading freight.
observation.result: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: Nessa hands over two clay and one mesh, enough for one product. Two clay and one mesh: plugs unlock three-coin sorting after Lowsail's tide; screening saves two stamina locally.
observation.result: Nessa hands over two clay and one mesh, enough for one product.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You press two clay and one mesh into repair plugs. Patch Stand at Lowsail unlocks three-coin sorting after the tide. Nessa's stock is spent; Patch Stand at Lowsail unlocks three-coin sorting after the tide.
observation.result: You press two clay and one mesh into repair plugs. Patch Stand at Lowsail unlocks three-coin sorting after the tide.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You load the freight and clear loose ash, spending two stamina. Nessa pays two coins; this job is finished. Nessa's stock is spent; Patch Stand at Lowsail unlocks three-coin sorting after the tide.
observation.result: You load the freight and clear loose ash, spending two stamina. Nessa pays two coins; this job is finished.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You return to Lowsail's changed market. Oren, Sava, and Mira watch families carry goods toward higher ground beyond the empty stalls.
observation.result: You return to Lowsail's changed market.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You use the repair plugs on Oren's raised sorting stand. Sort Dry Goods now pays three coins once. Oren's patched stand awaits dry goods uphill, beside families carrying stock from the empty stalls.
observation.result: You use the repair plugs on Oren's raised sorting stand. Sort Dry Goods now pays three coins once.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You sort dry goods on the patched stand. Oren pays three coins; the sorting job is finished. Oren's patched stand holds sorted goods uphill, beside families carrying stock from the empty stalls.
observation.result: You sort dry goods on the patched stand. Oren pays three coins; the sorting job is finished.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop. Nessa's clay, mesh, and freight job are spent; your workshop work remains finished.
observation.result: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop.
